schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one PR per repo instead of one per package

Group major updates by manager instead of one PR per package — this is the fix for the 18-PR fan-out found on a client site on 2026-08-10, where every major landed as its own PR despite dependencyDashboard-style grouping already being configured for minors
Automerge devDependencies once CI is green — they don't run in production, so a bad bump breaks the build loudly rather than shipping
Automerge patch bumps on any dependency type once CI is green — semver-safe by convention

Our own repos (reusable workflows, git-tag packages like drift-guards) skip the release-age wait and digest pinning. The wait protects against someone else's compromised release, not our own tags, and the timestamp-required default would hold a git tag with no release timestamp indefinitely. @v1 stays a tag, as the README intends

Our own tooling (repos tagged dd-tooling, minus the exclusions in renovate-tooling.json) also automerges minor bumps and lock file maintenance once every check is green; client sites and apps never do (founder, 17 November 2026). Renovate merges on its own daily run after reading the checks itself (platformAutomerge false), so a repo whose main requires no checks still waits for green. Placed before the house packages rule so house updates keep their own settings

House packages (@domandigital/*, craft above all) as soon as they are published, in their own group, merged once CI is green. They used to sit in the Monday group with 70 third-party packages, not automerged, so the Doman-Digital monorepo stayed on craft 0.5.0 while npm had 0.20.5 and copy-check ran old rules (DOM-1043). Last among the grouping rules so it wins; the rule above already skips the release-age wait for our own packages. No hourly or concurrent cap: on the first run a client repo's house PR was skipped because security PRs had used the hour's two, and a house release is one PR a repo

Stay on Node 24 across the estate and move together later (founder, 17 November 2026). Covers the node runtime wherever Renovate reads it: setup-node node-version in workflows, .nvmrc, engines.node, Dockerfile node images
Stay on pnpm 10 (founder, 17 November 2026): the packageManager field and the pnpm version pnpm/action-setup installs. The action itself still updates
phpunit stays below 13 until the PHP repos move together (founder, 17 November 2026)
Never bump a project's requires-python: it states which Pythons the package supports, a decision for a person, not a bot (founder, 17 November 2026)

Never update dd-ci-standards itself. Callers use @v1 (and #v1 for this preset), which moves with every release; Renovate rewrote it to fixed releases (v1.0.13, v1.0.22), and a pinned caller stops getting new rules (FW-003, 13 October 2026)
